english: 18b-20. On a Sunday in the bright half of the month of Āśvayuj (September-October), on the seventh day (when the Moon is) in conjunction with the constellation Uttarāṣāḍhā or on the twelfth day in conjunction with Uttarābhādrapadā constellation, the devotee shall come to Pāpavināśana and take his holy bath as enjoined (in the scriptures).
